dialogues.text: I've been waiting here for the longest time, and nobody came... I was only planning to rest my eyes for a bit, but the sofa was so comfy, I guess I dozed off...
Sure can! Talking is one of the things I can do. Alright, sooo... Ah, yes! Introductions are in order, aren't they?
Greetings, my dear guests. My name is... uh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, not sure we can help you with that one, buddy... Guess you were in a pretty deep sleep, huh? Seems like you're still waking up.

response.text: Huh? Really!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're, uh, just messing with you, hehe...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Anyway, Paimon's name is Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}. ...Okay, great, that went well. At least this mysterious room doesn't rob everyone of their memories.
I must apologize... I must have slept for so long that I can't remember what's real and what was a dream anymore. I did have a lot of dreams while I was asleep...

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Okay, concentrate... Alright, so — if I'm not mistaken... the current me is a "concierge," in charge of attending to any guests that find themselves here. Ah yes, and you may call me "Wolfy."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay. But, um, if all you can remember are your dreams, what makes you think any of them are real experiences? They're just products of your imagination, right?

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: You mean... If it comes from my imagination, it... can't be real life? Well, it sounds like you know more about that kind of thing than I do. I can't tell the difference at all...

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: I remember a time when a horrid curse was put on me. My heart was cased in unmelting ice, and I had to spend my days in agonizing solitude, surrounded by nothing but boundless tundra...

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: I also remember playing with White Fang in the misty forest. We chased golden butterflies, waded through rushing streams, and shattered the very moon beneath our feet...

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: And I'll never forget marching in that celebratory procession with the other troops, being showered in confetti as I excitedly waited for Her Majesty the Queen to bestow her honor upon me... Ah, it was glorious!

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: To me, all these events are indistinguishable from real experiences. Take my latest dream for instance. I remember being in a garden of forking paths, and Madame Mage said to me...

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: "From now on, you are a concierge. Be sure to treat your guests well!"

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Then I found myself here. And like I said, I waited, and waited, and waited... and now, finally, two guests have arrived! At last, I can fulfill my duty.

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Is there anything else you'd like to ask me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, who is this Madame Mage? Is she really just a figure from your dream? Seems like there could be more to it than just that...

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Well... Madame Mage is Madame Mage. Just as you, dear guests, are guests.

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Her and her friends — oh, yes, and they're all mages, too! Each one of them is a master of their own type of magic. Conjuring, illusions, and so on.

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: One of them uses a quill pen to cast her spells. She has a very mysterious ink bottle that contains "fantasy truth." I had a little taste when she wasn't looking, and oh my goodness, it was bitter... blech...

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: But the other mages all love her magic. They use their powers of creation to transform her "fantasy truth" into "true fantasy."

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: How do they do that? I haven't the slightest idea. I'm just a toy, with stuffing for brains...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, what is this place? We came in here through this one door in the library, but we were never able to open it before...

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Ah, well, congratulations on your successful entry, dear guests! This is a special room, one that can only be accessed by those who are invited!

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Seeing as you two have this privilege, you can invite your friends to enter as well!

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: On that note, I'd better tidy up this place as quickly as possible. Oh, and I should prepare some tea and snacks too. You don't mind if they're on the sweeter side, do you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course not! ...Wait, before we get ahead of ourselves, mind telling us where we are exactly? Are we even still in Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Hmm. That is a difficult question. Madame Mage created this room using magic, and I don't know magic...

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Still, you have my guarantee as concierge that this is a safe and comfortable place. I sincerely hope you enjoy your time here.

choices.text: About that book and the battle we just fought...

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Yes, I saw! You were magnificent! I was completely enraptured by your performance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...What do you mean "performance"?

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Well, Madame Mage says that every page of a storybook is a segment of the "present."

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: I'm sure only the most distinguished of guests are able to take the stage as the story's protagonists, and put on a show as spectacular as yours!

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: What a thrilling battle... Yes, that's what every story needs to spice things up! Naturally, those are the kinds of stories I love reading the most.

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: I wonder what would make a good title for a book about your magnificent performance? Should we call it a saga? An epic? A tale of conquest? A chronicle of combat? Ah, choices, choices.

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: In any case, I do hope you will be so kind as to indulge us with more of your fine performances. ...In fact, scratch that — I'm afraid I shall have to insist! The story of the "present" is waiting to be written, and you, dear guests, are the ones to fill its pages!

choices.text: That's all I wanted to ask.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This place is getting more confusing by the second... But Wolfy seems alright. So... we should be fine, right? Besides...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Our goal is to set foot in every corner of Teyvat... And the courage to boldly go where others dare not to tread is what will take us there.

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Wow, what a wonderful line! Spoken like a true adventurer!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You bet! We're the real deal!

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Is that so? Well then, I'd better make sure I do my duty as concierge of this place. I hope this can be somewhere for you to rest and recuperate when you're weary, so that you can embark on your next adventure refreshed and renewed.

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Come back here anytime if you get tired. I'll be sure to take good care of you!

choices.text: An Honorary Knight, much renowned and loved by all.
